achievements.name: Out of Prison
achievements.detail: Leave the Prisoner's Quarters through any of its exits.

achievements.name: Vine Rune
achievements.detail: Collect the Vine Rune so later runs can climb ivy.

achievements.name: The Concierge
achievements.detail: Defeat the Concierge on the Black Bridge.

achievements.name: Conjunctivius
achievements.detail: Defeat Conjunctivius in the Insufferable Crypt.

achievements.name: Time Keeper
achievements.detail: Defeat the Time Keeper in the Clock Room.

achievements.name: Hand of the King
achievements.detail: Defeat the Hand of the King in the Throne Room.

achievements.name: Boss Stem Cell
achievements.detail: Collect a Boss Stem Cell from the Hand of the King.

achievements.name: Blueprint Unlocked
achievements.detail: Spend cells at the Collector to unlock a blueprint permanently.

achievements.name: Legendary Forge
achievements.detail: Invest cells in the Legendary Forge to improve the quality of dropped gear.

achievements.name: Flawless Fight
achievements.detail: Defeat a boss without taking any damage in that fight.

achievements.name: The Giant
achievements.detail: Defeat the Giant in the Guardian's Haven.

achievements.name: Five-Cell Throne
achievements.detail: Defeat the Hand of the King with five Boss Stem Cells active.
